messages:
Maya (Marketing): Heads up — thinking about a two-step launch narrative for the new benchmark report + webinar. Idea: short press-style launch post that nails the econ story, then a deeper webinar where we demo routing + fallbacks. Want to iterate battlecards in between. Thoughts?

Tom (Growth): Love the two-step approach. Can we make the PR focused on a single punchline (e.g., 'reduce per-token cost by X with runtime-aware routing') so SDRs have a clean hook? :thumbsup:

Jess (Product): Agree on a crisp headline. For the webinar we should show a side-by-side flow: cloud-managed endpoint vs Redwood with Dedicated + fallback to cheaper quantized variant. Live demo of latency and cost charts would land well.

Ava (Sales): SDRs need 3 ready-made rebuttals and one-liners. If the PR is too technical they'll ignore it — but the benchmark numbers can back the rebuttals. Can we draft those 3 bullets today?

Maya (Marketing): Yes. Draft for the battlecard front-of-pack: 
```
- Headline hook: 'Inference-first: predictable latency, consistent cost'
- Quick claim: 'Typical customers see 20–40% lower per-token costs on real workloads vs cloud endpoint defaults'
- Differentiator: 'Unified runtime for hosted, dedicated, and private — same API, same controls'
```
Open to wording tweaks.

Tom (Growth): Those read well. Suggest adding 'graceful degradation' angle: show we don't go to 503s when a noisy tenant spikes. That's a tangible operational win for product teams.

Jess (Product): Add a one-liner about smart routing/fallbacks: 
"We route by latency, cost, and model quality — automatic fallback to compatible variants keeps SLAs intact."

Ava (Sales): For SDRs: 3 rebuttals draft — please keep them bite-sized.

Maya (Marketing): Draft rebuttals: 
1) "Why not just cloud endpoints?" — 'Cloud endpoints hide unit economics and don't offer cross-region routing or transparent fallback policies. We give you clear levers to trade cost vs latency.'
2) "Is this just quantization?" — 'Quantization is one lever; our platform couples quantization with batching, caching, and routing to preserve quality while cutting cost.'
3) "What about uptime and SLAs?" — 'Dedicated pools + automatic model variants provide predictable throughput and graceful degradation — customers keep serving even under stress.'

bench-bot: New benchmark draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/bench/draft_v1.csv — includes latency/cost per 1M tokens for three workloads.

Tom (Growth): Nice. Can we extract 2–3 'soundbites' from the bench for the PR? E.g., 'X% cost delta on retrieval-augmented generation workloads' and 'Yms median tail latency improvement'.

Jess (Product): I'll pull the RAG row and the median p95 numbers. Will post a short table.

Ava (Sales): Also need an objection handling card for 'we're invested in Vendor X' — short slide: migration path + pilot offer.

Maya (Marketing): Good call. Proposal timeline: 
- Today: finalize 3 rebuttals + 4-sentence PR lead + bench soundbites
- Tomorrow: updated battlecard PDF + SDR one-pager (2x A4)
- Post-webinar: expanded battlecard with logs/demo snippets
Does that work?

Tom (Growth): Works for me. I can prep SDR email templates once we have the one-pager.

Jess (Product): Posting the bench snippets now:
```
RAG workload (1M tokens): Redwood routing + dedicated pools = 28% lower cost vs CloudX baseline; p95 latency 220ms vs 320ms baseline.
Simple chat workload: 18% lower cost; p95 90ms vs 140ms.
```

Ava (Sales): Perfect. Can we make the SDR templates include 1) headline, 2) 1-sentence proof, 3) CTA (30 min pilot)? Keep it skimmable.

Maya (Marketing): Agreed. I'll assemble final PR lead and publish draft in #docs for review by EOD. Also planning a small rehearsal demo run-through with product for the webinar on Friday. Who can join?

Jess (Product): I'll be there. Tom, Ava?

Tom (Growth): I'll join for the rehearsal. Ava — can you make the pilot offer slide?

Ava (Sales): On it.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — will post the PR lead + battlecard draft in this thread when ready. :rocket:

bench-bot: Reminder scheduled: 'bench feedback review' tomorrow 10:00 AM calendar invite sent to participants.
